segment.source: Renders the editorial opening of a team section: an eyebrow, a heading, a lead and a paragraph of rich text, with up to two links onward. Use it for: the words above a team grid, an introduction to a careers page, a short statement about how the company is staffed. Prefer 'Team Facepile' when the introduction should already show faces, and 'Founder Story' when the text is a narrative rather than a section opener.
